details.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's (Zhipu AI) first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, accepting image and text input alongside text output, and a lighter sibling model to GLM-5.3. It uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture combining sparse and linear attention, with roughly 320 billion total parameters and about 18 billion active per token, and supports a 1,048,576-token context window. Z.ai describes it as delivering stronger intelligence than GLM-5.2, with a faster 'FlashX' inference variant available.
advantages: Z.ai describes it as the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, accepting image and text input (Z.ai docs).
Scores 63.4 on the Deep SWE coding benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 80.75 (mean) on ExtractBench, per its Hugging Face model card.
Combines sparse and linear attention with only about 18 billion of its 320 billion parameters active per token, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Documented language support is limited to English and Chinese (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Visual understanding and UI reproduction from screenshots
Multimodal coding and agentic tasks combining image and text input
Office document generation such as PPTX, DOCX and XLSX

notes: Z.ai's own docs describe this model additionally accepting video and file input, and one summary gave a shorter ~300K-token context figure, but Bud's catalog for this endpoint records only image_input/text_input/text_output modality and a 1,048,576 max input token count; this write-up follows the catalog's authoritative figures and leaves out the video/file input and shorter context claims accordingly.
